shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用逐级错落的斜列同时讲清一件版型与多件装的份量。
一秒给出核心主张，用抬臂姿态证明贴身却不勒、抬手不下摆外翻。
shots.textZone: right vertical band: one headline slot above two stacked callout slots on a denim indigo panel

shots.intent: 把版型说服力从正面转到正侧面，让买家确认腰身收位与后片长度。
让买家在上身效果之间做出颜色选择，同时坐实多件装的可分配场景。
用三段结构特写自证领口、袖摆与回弹做工，替买家回答耐穿吗。
shots.textZone: right label lane of each card: one short callout slot per band, three in total

shots.intent: 用规整的空参数表与洗护符号位消除尺码与护理疑虑，数值由卖家后填。
收口促成下单，用四格跨场景快照证明一衣多穿并留出一个行动位。
shots.textZone: upper-left corner one headline slot, lower-right corner one short button slot on the denim indigo field

style.backgroundSystem: matte seamless studio paper white #FFFFFF for the packshot and the side-profile screen, flat warm sand paper fields #F4EAD5 for the benefit hero and the spec card, warm greige #EDE7DB for the colorway row and the gutter lines of the three-card detail screen, one denim indigo panel field #4A6E8A for the rear silhouette screen and the closing collage; flat low-contrast surfaces only, no gradient, no storefront lettering
style.direction: warm premium womens basics apparel commerce
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line marks only, mustard #D8A32B used solely as a short underline bar or a slim button outline
style.lightingSystem: warm daylight-balanced studio light around 5200K, large front-right softbox key with a bounce fill on the shadow side, soft low-contrast shadows that always keep a contact shadow grounding the garment; low sweeping skimming light across the knit only inside the macro cards to read the fabric face
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm premium womens-basics apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio white #FFFFFF, warm sand #F4EAD5, denim indigo #4A6E8A and one mustard accent #D8A32B; warm daylight-balanced studio lighting around 5200K with a large front-right softbox key, bounce fill on the shadow side and soft low-contrast contact shadows that always ground the garment; matte seamless paper cyclorama, flat warm sand paper fields and one denim indigo panel field only; modern geometric sans-serif set in denim indigo with hairline mustard underline bars and never dense body copy; consistent thin single-weight line icon style; garment always shown with a readable ribbed crew neckline, both short sleeve hems and the fitted side seam, worn by a generic faceless body cropped above the collarbone; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no identifiable model face or celebrity likeness
no invented fabric weights, percentages, measurements, size figures or test results
style.presentationRules: the garment always shows the ribbed crew neckline, both short sleeve hems and the fitted side seam; on-body screens crop the body above the collarbone so no face is ever carried; scale and centering of the worn piece stay stable across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper cyclorama for on-body screens, warm greige paper counter for the colorway row, smooth pale plaster-like plane behind the four lifestyle snapshots
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif in denim indigo #4A6E8A, one family only, one headline plus at most three short callouts, hairline mustard underline bars, never dense body copy
